title: Autonomous upgrade gatekeeper for private controlplanes
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement an autonomous Upgrade Gatekeeper service and Terraform module set to orchestrate safe, auditable control plane version promotions for Private (VPC) deployments. The Gatekeeper must perform dry-run planning, cohorted rollouts, telemetry-driven gating, automated rollback on regressions, and emit audit events to the private audit sink. This ticket covers the engineering implementation, IaC changes (versioned TF modules with upgrade hooks), health probes, and a rollout playbook for on-call engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper runs a plan-only Terraform run against a target VPC and reports drift/errors without applying changes
Support defining promotion cohorts (cohort size, selection criteria) and staging windows in a config CRD or TF variable

Telemetry gating evaluates at least 5 signals (p95 token latency, inference error rate, control-plane reconcile errors, KV cache miss rate, host CPU) and blocks progression when thresholds are breached
Automated rollback trigger is implemented: if a canary cohort breaches a gate within 30m of promotion, Gatekeeper reverts the promoted nodes and records a reversible action in the audit log
Gatekeeper exposes a dry-run and a 'force-promote' manual override accessible to SREs with RBAC logged to audit sink
End-to-end test harness (GitHub Actions + local minikube) validates a staged promotion and rollback scenario
Terraform modules include state-locking and plan-output artifacts for manual review (s3/remote state + plan uploads)
Documentation: Confluence PRD, runbook, and a sample terraform snippet included in docs
implementation_plan: Week 1: Design API for Gatekeeper (promotion CRD or control-plane config) and define telemetry signals + thresholds
Week 2: Prototype Terraform orchestration flow (plan -> approval -> apply) using existing TF modules; implement plan-only and plan artifact upload
Week 3: Integrate telemetry evaluator and gating logic; wire alerting hooks and automatic rollback path
Week 4: Add cohort selection & traffic shadowing support, implement RBAC for force-promote, and add audit event streaming
Week 5: End-to-end tests, runbook, and small private rollout with staging tenants
rollout_playbook: Preflight: run Gatekeeper dry-run against staging VPC and verify plan artifacts in s3
Canary: promote 5% of tenants for 1 hour, monitor automated gating metrics (p95, error-rate, reconcile-failures)
Gate evaluation: if any metric crosses threshold, Gatekeeper automatically reverts and posts incident note to #sre-private-upgrades
Manual override: SREs can call force-promote via the Console CLI with justification; action is logged
Post-promotion: run validation suite (integration tests + smoke checks) and mark promotion complete in audit log
